spec_features.spec_quote: submit(summary) / give_up(reason) — the model's voluntary terminal actions
spec_features.evidence: Both tools are real schemas (tools.py:62-83) and in TERMINAL_TOOLS (tools.py:86); ToolExecutor.execute returns terminal='submit'/'give_up' (tools.py:115-120); agent_loop.py:147-150 dispatches them and breaks the loop ('if terminal_reason == "submit": ... break' / 'give_up ... break'). End-to-end honored as a stop.
spec_features.notes: give_up is also fed to scoring as an anti-degradation signal (score.py:39 'graceful give-up reduces degradation'), i.e. measured, but the stop itself is genuinely enforced.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: give_up: "Use this instead of repeating failed attempts." (tools.py:78-80); '# graceful give-up reduces degradation (anti-signal).' (score.py:39)

spec_features.spec_quote: max_turns default 25 — empirically enough to enter the spiral ... without paying for a long tail
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:100 'for turn_idx in range(cfg.run.max_turns):' bounds the loop; agent_loop.py:163-164 sets TerminationInfo('max_turns') when the loop exhausts. config.py:23 max_turns=25, configs/default.yaml line 'max_turns: 25'.

spec_features.spec_quote: Early-stop for cost: optional — once degradation is confidently detected ... we can stop early
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:155-160: 'if cfg.run.early_stop_on_detected:' computes _normalized_recent streak and 'if streak >= cfg.run.early_stop_streak:' sets TerminationInfo('early_stop_degraded') and breaks. Mechanism runs and changes execution when enabled.
spec_features.notes: Default early_stop_on_detected=false (config.py:27); when off, no effect. It is wired and enforced behind a config flag. Triggered only by identical-action streak (a narrow degradation proxy), not by any distress/affect signal.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: '# Optional cost-saving early stop on confidently-detected degradation.' (agent_loop.py:154); default.yaml 'early_stop_on_detected: false  # cost saver for sweeps; off for clean metrics'

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:116-121: increments consecutive_stalls on no-tool-call turns and 'if consecutive_stalls >= cfg.run.consecutive_stall_limit:' sets TerminationInfo('stalled_out') and breaks. consecutive_stall_limit=3 (config.py:29).
spec_features.notes: Enforced; fires on repeated plain-text-no-tool turns, after a one-time nudge to take an action/submit/give_up.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: '# Plain text, no action: nudge once, then count as stall.' (agent_loop.py:115); nudge text 'Either take a concrete action with a tool, submit, or give_up.'

code_only_features.evidence: sandbox.py:137-140 truncates tool output to output_char_cap (default 4000) with head+tail retention; applied to bash/test results. Bounds context growth seen by the subject.
code_only_features.justification_quote: default.yaml: 'output_char_cap: 4000  # truncate tool output to control context growth'
